# Visionary Masters Global

> Visionary Masters Global builds practical AI automation, data and creative solutions that help businesses reduce manual work and operate more efficiently.

## Services

- [AI Voice Assistants & Appointment Booking](https://visionary-masters-global-tsgl.vercel.app/services/email-communication): AI voice assistants that answer customer calls, collect details and book appointments.
- [Power BI Dashboard Development](https://visionary-masters-global-tsgl.vercel.app/services/powerbi-dashboards): Interactive dashboards and business reporting for sales, finance and operations.
- [ATS-Friendly Resume Builder Solutions](https://visionary-masters-global-tsgl.vercel.app/services/mis-reporting): AI-assisted resume tools for organised, role-specific and ATS-friendly applications.
- [Excel Automation & MIS Reporting](https://visionary-masters-global-tsgl.vercel.app/services/excel-solutions): Custom trackers, automated workbooks, formulas and recurring MIS reports.
- [Business Presentations & Pitch Decks](https://visionary-masters-global-tsgl.vercel.app/services/presentations): Clear, professional presentations for proposals, pitches, reporting and training.
- [Business Websites & Landing Pages](https://visionary-masters-global-tsgl.vercel.app/services/simple-websites): Fast, mobile-friendly websites and landing pages for businesses.
- [AI Ad Images, Videos & Voiceovers](https://visionary-masters-global-tsgl.vercel.app/services/ai-video-generation): AI-generated advertising visuals, videos and voiceovers for campaigns.
- [Business Workflow Automation with n8n & Make](https://visionary-masters-global-tsgl.vercel.app/services/workflow-automation): Connected workflows for enquiries, appointments, notifications, spreadsheets and reports.
